content.intro: Learn why is mysql used? in the context of introduction to mysql. This lesson covers the supplied syllabus topic, demonstrates a representative MySQL example, and finishes with a verification task.
content.why_it_matters: MySQL is commonly selected when applications need persistent relational data, joins, constraints, transactions, indexing, and broad connector support. Selection should follow workload, operational capability, and feature requirements rather than popularity alone.
